label: POST HOC (docs/findings/margin-rtest-plan.md). Written on 26 Nov 2026, before any margin network was run on an R_TEST circuit.
basis: E0 under the same harness: R-dev to R_TEST, the median network's circuits completed went 8 to 8 and its median gap 6.35% to 5.16% (a factor 0.81). The margin networks on R-dev: 11, 12, 12, 11, 11 circuits; the median network completes 94.2% of laps at a median gap of 7.16%.

median gap to the reference lap, median network

reading_rule.transfers: the one-sided exact permutation p for circuits completed, margin above E0, five against five, is at most 0.05, and the median margin network completes at least 10 of 12
reading_rule.does_not_transfer: the margin networks' mean circuits completed is less than 1.0 above E0's 8.2
reading_rule.h1_as_written: read on the median margin network, descriptively: at least 90% of laps and a median gap of at most 4%. Expected: the lap part is close to call, the gap part fails.
